record.title: Slovak hauliers renew inbound freight blockade at Vyšné Nemecké in December 2023
record.scope: Intentional obstruction of inbound commercial freight at one road crossing
record.movement: Trucks travelling from Ukraine into Slovakia
record.exceptions: Passenger movement and trucks travelling from Slovakia into Ukraine were not blocked by this action.
record.imposing_authority: Union of Road Hauliers of Slovakia (UNAS), non-state protesters
record.enforcement: Protesters placed vehicles across the inbound truck route; police and UNAS confirmed the renewed obstruction.
record.consequences: Freight backlog and restricted throughput; no independent loss estimate entered.
record.relationship: Separate recurrence from R4-EU-006 (1–4 December 2023), with an intervening cessation. Promotes the December portion of R4-EU-L005; November remains unresolved.
record.status_observation: Historical evidence only; no status inference at 21 October 2026
record.official_rationale: UNAS demanded reinstatement of transport permits for Ukrainian hauliers, alleging unfair competition.
record.context: Renewed action after the separately documented 1–4 December blockade. Limited truck passage resumed before protesters ended the action.
record.uncertainty: 13 December endpoint is first documented partial resumption at 19:30, not full removal. UNAS ended its blockade on 14 December at 21:00. Times are retained as reported without assuming matching time zones.

historical.duration_note: Not eligible for a single continuous-duration calculation; see movement scope, phases and uncertainty. No computed duration: endpoint captures limited passage while obstruction continued until the following day.

claim_checks.Historical note — current findings are i: UNAS blockade reported in place after 15:00 December 11 with police confirmation.
Official Ukrainian border service reports partial truck clearance from December 13 at 19:30; full blockade removal December 14 at 21:00 separate.
